what: The white handle of the floating pill menu rests under the current page cell, and when the panel-opening cell (Contact) is pressed it slides to that cell in .46s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.18,1), while small panels at the top right of the pill rise from 8px below and transparent on the same curve — the panel nearest the pill first, the others .1s and .2s later. Pressing outside or another cell folds the panels and the handle returns to the current page cell

options.dur: Handle · panel length (s), default .46 — 0 means instant
options.each: Delay between panels (s), default .1 — the panel closest to the pill goes first
options.ease: Curve of type ‹0.77,0,0.18,1›, default is that
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Pill slot (required) — aria-current="page" The handle stands in the cell marked with this (first cell if none). The cell that opens the panel gets data-pop
options.[data-fx-part=pop] > [data-fx-part=card]: Panels floating above the pill (optional) — place them in top-to-bottom order

from.where: shared.js·shared.css bottom-center pill menu .dt-nav (handle Work 0·About 100·Contact 204px, two contact panels with nth-child delays .2s·.1s, clicking outside the panel closes it)

note: The original has cells of equal 100px width, so handle positions are hard-coded in px — the part measures each cell’s position and width and follows them, so cell widths can differ
